conditional_dependency_semantics: Require a conditional predecessor only when its source/provider output is selected as input or advertised as confirmed by the final acceptance/release claim. Merely shipping an optional feature does not assert its live qualification. Unselected/missing optional resources never block independent core use; selected unsupported claims remain explicit.
purchased_credits: forbidden without explicit personal approval for the individual case; this planning request grants none
excluded_llm_benchmark_campaigns: bulk model benchmark runs, including the 732-stimulus population
llm_functional_verification: Reuse valid receipts and deterministic cases; use only necessary authorized functional calls within actual remaining included/free/local limits. No extra inference for UI review, report arithmetic, diagnostics or evidence export. No purchased credits/overage or silent provider fallback.
coverage_sources: latest user budget amendment and explicit quoted source reports
